triples.tail_surface: remote means of controls situated outside the space in which they are located so that they may be stopped in the event of fire in that space
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 位于泵所在处所外部的遥控装置以便在火灾时停泵
triples.evidence_text: Fuel oil transfer pumps are to be fitted with remote means of controls situated outside the space in which they are located so that they may be stopped in the event of fire in that space.

triples.tail_surface: Fixed fire-extinguishing system capable of activation from outside the room

triples.evidence_text: iii) Fixed fire-extinguishing system capable of activation from outside the room.

triples.head_surface: fuel oil purifiers for heated oil
triples.tail_surface: Means of closing ventilation openings and stopping the ventilation fans, purifiers, purifier-feed pumps, etc. from a position close to where the fire extinguishing system is activated

triples.evidence_text: iv) Means of closing ventilation openings and stopping the ventilation fans, purifiers, purifier-feed pumps, etc. from a position close to where the fire extinguishing system is activated.

triples.tail_surface: local fixed water-based fire-extinguishing system complying with the provisions of 4-7-2/1.11.2

triples.evidence_text: In such cases, a local fixed water-based fire-extinguishing system complying with the provisions of 4-7-2/1.11.2 is to be provided.
